evidence.title: Fliki - Turn Any Idea Into Video With 2,000+ AI Voices
About Fliki: The AI Video and Voice Platform

name: Fliki
summary: AI video generator that turns scripts, blog posts and slides into narrated videos with 2,000+ voices.
description: Web-based text-to-video platform: paste a prompt, script, blog URL or PowerPoint (or drop in raw footage) and get a publish-ready video with AI voiceover, stock visuals, subtitles, music and transitions. Adds AI avatars and digital twins, voice cloning, an image and thumbnail generator, video series planning with auto-publishing, translation, dubbing and an enterprise text-to-speech API.
contains: 10M+ stock images, video clips and music tracks
70+ AI avatars and digital twins from a photo and voice sample
video series planning with auto-scheduling and publishing
turns ideas, scripts, blogs, PPTs and raw clips into videos
free plan with 3 credits/mo; enterprise text-to-speech API at developer.fliki.ai
